en: Color postcard showing a wooded mountain landscape with a green lake and small boats. On the shore there is a resort building with two turret-like roofs, part of the Băile Tușnad spa area. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, address lines, a Romanian stamp (40 bani, Poșta Română), and postmarks from Băile Tușnad and București. The printed caption identifies the view as Lacul Ciucaș.
